info.title: CRM API
info.description: REST API of the open-source CRM for non-governmental organizations.

post.summary: Authenticates a user and issues access and refresh tokens.
Refreshes an expired access token using a valid refresh token.
Logs out the currently authenticated user by revoking their refresh token.
Generates an invitation link/token for a new user.

get.summary: Validates an invitation token and returns its underlying details.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: The query containing the invitation token.

post.summary: Completes the user registration and onboarding process using a valid invitation token.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific login page image by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the image to retrieve.

delete.summary: Deletes an existing login page image by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the image to delete.

post.summary: Creates a new login page image in the system.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of available login page images.

parameters.name: SearchTerm
parameters.description: The pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters.

get.summary:
Retrieves a random login page image.
This endpoint is unprotected and intended for public use on the login screen.
Retrieves the details of an NGO by its unique identifier.

post.summary: Creates a new NGO in the system.

put.summary: Updates an existing NGO in the system.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of user roles.

parameters.name: SearchTerm
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and sorting.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and sorting.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and sorting.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and sorting.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and sorting.

post.summary: Creates a new role in the system.

get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific role by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the role to update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the role to delete.

get.summary: Retrieves all system-defined access rights available for assignment to roles.

post.summary: Adds a specific permission claim to an existing role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the role.

parameters.name: claimValue
parameters.description: The value of the permission claim to add.

delete.summary: Removes a specific permission claim from an existing role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the role.

parameters.name: claimValue
parameters.description: The value of the permission claim to remove.

get.summary:
Retrieves the current onboarding and setup status of the CRM system.
Used by the frontend to determine whether to show the initial setup wizard.
Retrieves a paginated and filtered list of users.

parameters.name: SearchTerm
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: ShowDeleted
parameters.description: The query parameters for filtering and pagination.

post.summary: Creates a new user (typically used only for the first system admin initialization).

delete.summary: Permanently deletes a specific user and all associated personal data (GDPR hard-delete).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to delete.

get.summary: Retrieves the detailed profile of a specific user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user.

put.summary: Updates the profile details of an existing user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to update.

get.summary: Retrieves the detailed profile of the currently authenticated user.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes the currently authenticated user's account and all associated personal data (GDPR hard-delete).

put.summary: Updates the profile details of the currently authenticated user.

post.summary: Securely changes the password for the currently authenticated user.

get.summary:
Retrieves the list of unique UI permissions for the currently authenticated user.
Used by the client application to build the user interface dynamically.

post.summary: Adds a custom key-value field to the currently authenticated user's profile.

delete.summary: Removes a specific custom field from the currently authenticated user's profile.

parameters.name: customFieldId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the custom field to remove.

put.summary: Updates the value of a specific custom field for the currently authenticated user.

parameters.name: customFieldId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the custom field to update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to activate.

post.summary: Deactivates an active user (soft delete and lock identity account).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to deactivate.

post.summary: Adds a custom key-value field to a specific user's profile.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user.

delete.summary: Removes a specific custom field from a specific user's profile.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user.

parameters.name: customFieldId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the custom field to remove.

put.summary: Updates the value of a specific custom field for a specific user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user.

parameters.name: customFieldId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the custom field to update.

post.summary: Assigns a new role to the specified user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user.

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the role to assign.

delete.summary: Removes a specific role from the specified user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user.

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the role to remove.

key.description: The unique key or name of the custom field.

value.description: The string value of the custom field.

isPublic.description: A value indicating whether the custom field is visible to other regular users.

AddCustomFieldRequest.description: Represents a request to add a new custom key-value field to a user profile.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token to revoke for the current device session.

LogoutRequest.description: Request to log out the currently authenticated user by revoking their refresh token.

value.description: The new string value for the custom field.

isPublic.description: A value indicating whether the custom field is visible to other regular users.

UpdateCustomFieldRequest.description: Represents a request to update the value of an existing custom key-value field.

currentPassword.description: The current password of the user.

UpdatePasswordRequest.description: Command to update the password for the currently authenticated user.

internalPosition.description: The updated internal position or job title within the NGO.

pronounCategory.description: The updated grammatical category of pronouns.

avatarUrl.description: The updated avatar URL or file path.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Represents a command to update the profile details of the currently authenticated user.

newName.description: The new name to assign to the role.

feminitiveName.description: The optional feminitive form of the role name.

pluralName.description: The optional plural form of the role name.

UpdateRoleRequest.description: Request DTO for updating a role's details without duplicating the ID in the body.
